what: A tool call outside the agent's allow list asks the person in the chat (Claude Code: a PermissionRequest hook handed in per run with --settings, never the person's own settings): a permission question with Allow / Deny (permission: true), a thumbs up / down or a plain yes / no while exactly one question is open; no answer within KALMIDO_PERM_TIMEOUT (default 9 min) = denied, no runner = denied at once, a late answer gets a note; KALMIDO_PERM_RELAY=0 switches it off; commands without hooks: off; 2.126.0: only the agent's operator answers (KALMIDO_PERM_USER, the owner, KALMIDO_OWNER_IDS), anyone else chatting gets the step denied with a note
